25: A shared byte budget issues owned reservations before allocation. Reservations
26: are released on drop, including error and cancellation paths. Growth is checked
27: against remaining shared capacity before publishing a larger retained state.
28: Arithmetic overflow and over-budget requests fail explicitly. A reservation is
29: not a general-purpose allocator: every admitted producer and stateful operator
30: must charge owned buffers and capacity before making an enforcement claim.
31: 
32: Queue slots, queued bytes, active input, decoded buffers, operator state, merge
33: state, source caches, and output ownership are separate measured consumers of the
34: same budget. Moving a buffer transfers its reservation instead of charging a
35: second copy. Sharing a buffer retains its owner until the final reference drops.
36: Do not release memory credits merely because a task has returned a retained result.
37: 
38: Persistent workers pull bounded work dynamically. Logical partitions and reduction
39: order preserve floating-point semantics independently of physical worker assignment.
40: Task failures cancel further work and drain already submitted work before returning.
41: Caller-owned runtime shutdown joins workers. The Vortex I/O progress service and
42: compression workers participate in the engine's CPU budget.

46: Prepared sources retain an open source handle and source-generation identity.
47: Replacement, truncation, mutation, and recreation invalidate prepared operations.
48: Path or size alone does not certify immutable data. Source identity is checked at
49: operation boundaries, and concurrent mutation fails instead of returning mixed data.
50: Owned Vortex arrays and selection views remain executable payloads; descriptive
51: reports cannot stand in for them. Result ownership outlives sessions when requested.

1: //! Disjoint scopes on the caller thread; provider worker activity may overlap them.
2: 
3: use super::{Result, ShardLoomError};
4: 
5: #[derive(Default)]
6: pub(super) struct AggregateFirstPassTiming {
7:     pub scan_next_nanos: u128,
8:     pub reader_evidence_nanos: u128,
9:     pub accessor_nanos: u128,
10:     pub group_update_nanos: u128,
11:     pub finalization_nanos: u128,
12:     pub accessor_chunks: u64,
13:     pub accessor_rows: u64,
14: }
15: 
16: impl AggregateFirstPassTiming {
17:     pub(super) fn annotate_summary(&self, summary: &mut String) -> Result<()> {
18:         let mut payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(summary)
19:             .map_err(|error| ShardLoomError::InvalidOperation(error.to_string()))?;
20:         let object = payload.as_object_mut().ok_or_else(|| {
21:             ShardLoomError::InvalidOperation("aggregate summary must be an object".into())
22:         })?;
23:         for (key, value) in [
24:             ("aggregate_first_pass_scan_next_nanos", self.scan_next_nanos),
25:             (
26:                 "aggregate_first_pass_reader_evidence_nanos",
27:                 self.reader_evidence_nanos,
28:             ),
29:             ("aggregate_first_pass_accessor_nanos", self.accessor_nanos),
30:             (
31:                 "aggregate_first_pass_group_update_nanos",
32:                 self.group_update_nanos,
33:             ),
34:             (
35:                 "aggregate_result_finalization_nanos",
36:                 self.finalization_nanos,
37:             ),
38:             (
39:                 "aggregate_first_pass_accessor_chunks",
40:                 u128::from(self.accessor_chunks),
41:             ),
42:             (
43:                 "aggregate_first_pass_accessor_rows",
44:                 u128::from(self.accessor_rows),
45:             ),
46:         ] {
47:             object.insert(key.into(), u64::try_from(value).unwrap_or(u64::MAX).into());
48:         }
49:         object.insert("aggregate_timing_scope".into(),
50:             "disjoint_caller_elapsed_scopes_first_pass_scan_next_reader_evidence_compact_group_accessors_and_updates_plus_final_result_render_not_cpu_or_complete_wall;scan_next_includes_provider_progress;residual_row_updates_and_later_passes_not_instrumented".into());
51:         *summary = payload.to_string();
